releases.title: Authentication and Account Components
releases.summary: Added avatar and verification components, expanded authentication flows, and improved keyboard accessibility across interactive components.

items.text: Added 29 editable loading indicators adapted from loading-dev, with accessible labels and reduced-motion support.
Added individual and grouped avatars with initials fallback, plus an expanding account menu with configurable actions, continuous hover, and optional morphing sign-out confirmation.
Added a configurable verification code input with six slots by default, numeric entry, paste, and one-time-code autofill.

Expanded sign-up and password recovery with optional link and OTP flows, shared-element transitions, animated button states, and configurable OTP resend countdowns. Default continuations remain application-owned.
Updated authentication previews, usage examples, and API documentation for the new flows and callbacks.
Improved focus handling, keyboard navigation, and accessible semantics across interactive controls, overlays, calendars, charts, and notifications.

releases.title: Rhoe UI Identity
releases.summary: Completed the Rhoe UI rename across the public package, documentation, registry, and internal namespaces.

items.text: Renamed all remaining Sya UI branding, package metadata, storage keys, utility classes, and internal namespaces to Rhoe UI. Existing custom CSS overrides using the --sya-* prefix should be renamed to --rhoe-*.

releases.title: Overlays, Date Pickers, and Range Selection
releases.summary: Added drawer and sheet overlays, form-ready date pickers, date range selection in Calendar, and expanded motion tokens.

items.text: Published new overlay and date selection components.
Added range selection mode to Calendar with continuous range highlighting.
Added considered, reveal, and expand duration tokens plus an enter easing token to the shared CSS and Motion React foundation.
Input expanded content now reads its transition duration and easing from CSS variables.

releases.title: Charts, Data Display, and Modal Overlays
releases.summary: Added data visualization components, interactive tables, modal overlays, meters, authentication blocks, refined motion transitions, and Schema.org WebSite structured data.

items.text: Published a new set of data visualization, table, and overlay components.
Published new composed dashboard and authentication blocks.
Added Schema.org WebSite JSON-LD structured data for Google Search Site Name branding.
Refined animations, keyboard interactions, and responsive behaviors across core components.
Updated interactive scheduling flow and date handling in composed blocks.

releases.title: Initial public preview
releases.summary: The first public foundation for Rhoe UI, its editable component registry, documentation, and reusable interface patterns.

items.text: Published the initial set of editable Rhoe UI components.
Published the first composed scheduling block.
Added shared CSS and Motion React tokens for consistent transitions, springs, morphing, and reduced-motion behavior.
Published documentation with live previews, installation commands, usage examples, API references, theming, and motion guidance.
Added synchronized installation commands for pnpm, npm, yarn, and Bun.
